title.narrative: Abidjan Sustainable and Integrated Urban Mobility Project

description.narrative:
The Project Development Objective is to improve access to economic and social opportunities, increase the efficiency of the public transportation system along the Boulevard Latrille (main north-south corridor) as well as its feeder lines in the commune of Cocody, and contribute to the implementation of the Integrated Multimodal Transport System (SMIT) of Abidjan.
Specifically, the project aims to improve the attractiveness of public transport along the Bouvelard Latrille by increasing the number of people transported by BRT by 2,500,000, improving the commercial speed of SOTRA buses by 5 km/h and building the capacity of 2,500 artisanal transporters. The project will also help to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by renewing 500 informal transport vehicles and using gas-powered buses for public transport.
